## Profile

### Amlandeep Bhadra
_Head of Engineering · Strobe Labs_
- Location: New York, New York
- Currently: Head of Engineering, Strobe Labs
- Education: B.A. Computer Science & Mathematics, NYU
- Writes: Zig, Rust, Go, Elixir

Engineering lead based in New York. I run engineering at Strobe Labs, where a team of three took PerpCity, a perpetual futures exchange for real-world data, from first commit to Arbitrum mainnet.

I also write open-source systems code: eth.zig, a Zig Ethereum library faster than alloy.rs on 18 of 26 benchmarks, and a compiler_rt division speedup merged into the Zig compiler.

Before that: the execution engine for a layer 1 for AI agents at Talus Labs, the Flow protocol at Dapper Labs, and backend work at Audible, Twitter, and Goldman Sachs.

Studied Computer Science and Mathematics at NYU, where a minor in Studio Art left a lasting soft spot for interfaces that feel crafted. This site is one of them.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amlandeep-bhadra/)

## Experience

### Strobe Labs
_Head of Engineering · Dec 2024 – Present_
- Role: Head of Engineering
- Dates: Dec 2024 – Present
- Location: New York, NY

Took a perpetual futures exchange for real-world data from first commit to Arbitrum mainnet with a team of three, ahead of venture-backed competitors: 60 markets, 19,000 trades, and $760K in volume in under six months.

Built the inference pipeline behind the model-based indices: models scoring live data on SageMaker and RunPod GPUs via ONNX, publishing prices on-chain continuously, with zkML proofs of inference (EZKL) on testnet.

Designed and run the production platform: 13 services on AWS ECS covering an oracle network for 51 data feeds, a real-time indexer, streaming APIs, and liquidators, with KMS-held signing keys and paged on-call; 99.97% trading app availability over 90 days.

Shipped a public API platform for programmatic and AI-agent trading: an API in Elixir, a trade executor using policy-scoped session keys, and a CLI on npm.

Hired and lead the engineering team while staying hands-on: wrote the oracle service in Rust (1.3M+ on-chain transactions sent through a load-balanced pool of KMS-held wallets, in 26 MB of memory) and the liquidation bot in Zig; created eth.zig, an open-source Zig Ethereum library.
- [eth.zig on GitHub](https://github.com/StrobeLabs/eth.zig)

### Dapper Labs
_Protocol Engineer · Jan 2022 – Dec 2023_
- Role: Protocol Engineer
- Dates: Jan 2022 – Dec 2023
- Location: New York, NY · Remote

Scaled and extended the egress layer of Flow, the layer 1 behind NBA Top Shot, at its peak the largest consumer app in crypto. All of this work is open source.

Launched and optimized Flow’s Archive Node, enabling smart contract execution and transaction simulation outside the staked network, plus historical script execution beyond the live network’s 300-block window.

Enabled script execution and execution-data indexing on staked Access Nodes, reducing staked egress network traffic by 80%.

Led the Unstaked Observer Node launch, mentoring an intern and a junior engineer and coordinating a contractor team.

Led the final engineering effort to list the FLOW token on Coinbase.

Optimized the validator node software for hardware and network latency.
- [flow-go on GitHub](https://github.com/onflow/flow-go)

## Open Source

### eth.zig
_Zig Ethereum client library · creator_
- Language: Zig, zero dependencies
- Benchmarks: Faster than alloy.rs on 18 of 26
- Listed: ethereum.org developer docs

A pure-Zig Ethereum library: ABI, RLP, secp256k1, Keccak-256, HD wallets, EIP-712, JSON-RPC, WebSocket, ENS, and ERC-20/721, with function selectors and event topics computed at compile time.

Benchmarked against alloy.rs, Rust’s leading Ethereum library, with the harness and the five losses published: RLP EIP-1559 encode 24x, ABI dynamic decode 8.4x, secp256k1 sign and recover 4.2x.
- [eth.zig on GitHub](https://github.com/StrobeLabs/eth.zig)
- [ethzig.org](https://ethzig.org)
- [ethereum.org listing (PR #19213)](https://github.com/ethereum/ethereum-org-website/pull/19213)

### Zig compiler
_compiler_rt division speedup · merged_
- Project: ziglang/zig
- Merged: Mar 2026

Replaced the shift-subtract loop in compiler_rt’s udivmod large-divisor path with a constant-time trial quotient (Knuth Algorithm D): 87ns to 7.5ns, 11.5x faster on worst-case divisors on Apple M1.
- [ziglang/zig PR #31381](https://codeberg.org/ziglang/zig/pulls/31381)

### Foundry
_Anvil EIP-2935 support · merged_
- Project: foundry-rs/foundry
- Merged: Mar 2026

Added EIP-2935 blockhash history storage to Anvil, Foundry’s local Ethereum node.
- [foundry-rs/foundry PR #13588](https://github.com/foundry-rs/foundry/pull/13588)

### Flow protocol
_flow-go, flow-archive, rosetta · Dapper Labs_

129 pull requests to the onflow organization in Go: the Archive Node, Access Node script execution, the GetRegisters gRPC API, and Pebble-based storage.
- [onflow/flow-go](https://github.com/onflow/flow-go)

### lean-explain
_Lean 4 proofs, explained in English_

Step-by-step natural-language explanations of Lean 4 proofs, grounded in the goal states the compiler reports at each tactic.
- [lean-explain on GitHub](https://github.com/koko1123/lean-explain)
